recentItems.title: USA Life Reality : Dollars, Immigration Fears & NRI Struggles | Vishwadath Exclusive Interview
recentItems.description:
#idreamnews #idreamupdates #idreammediainterviews #teluguinterviews 
USA Life Reality : Dollars, Immigration Fears & NRI Struggles | Vishwadath Exclusive Interview
#NRILife #USA #TeluguNRIs ##AnchorLumbini


In this special iDream interview from New Jersey, host Lumbini speaks with Vishwadath, popular for sharing NRI updates through his social media page, about the real-life experiences of Telugu people living in the United States.

From H1B visa uncertainty and immigration challenges to reverse migration, job opportunities and the growing Telugu community, this conversation explores the realities of NRI life in America.

Topics discussed in this interview:

What is the real lifestyle of Indians in the USA?

Is the American Dream still worth pursuing?

H1B visa challenges and immigration uncertainty

Should Indian students and fresh graduates move to the USA?

Why are some NRIs returning to India?

Is Hyderabad becoming a better option for Telugu NRIs?

How social media immigration news creates anxiety

Telugu people and their growing influence in the USA

Telugu movie celebrations and fan culture in America

Local politics and business networks among Telugu communities

What should people know before planning to move to the USA?

Watch this complete conversation to understand the opportunities, challenges and changing realities of NRI life in America.

Host: Lumbini
Guest: Vishwadath
Show: iDream – NRI Special
